The Minish Cap for macOS (native port of the zeldaret/tmc decompilation)
Runs on macOS 12 Monterey or later, on Intel and Apple silicon Macs.

1. Move The Minish Cap.app to Applications (or anywhere you like).

2. The first time, open it with right-click (or Control-click) on The Minish Cap.app,
   choose Open, then Open again in the alert. A double-click only says the
   app can't be checked, because it isn't signed by a registered developer.
   (If there is no Open button: try once, then System Preferences > Security
   & Privacy > General > Open Anyway.)

3. When it asks, choose your own copy of The Minish Cap (USA) ROM (.gba).
   The app contains no game data; it extracts what it needs from your ROM
   into ~/Library/Application Support/tmc_macos (about 13 MB).

Keys and controller settings are in the app's Settings window.
